thinking:
"快送外卖" (KuaiSong Delivery), a food delivery service in Chengdu.
Students and office workers.
Home page (with categories), Restaurant list page, Restaurant detail page (dishes + prices), Order confirmation page.
Enable users to choose food and place orders.

        *   Static website (deployable).
        *   Multiple files (index.html + at least 2 others).
        *   Relative paths, same tab navigation.
        *   Internal CSS/JS (no remote assets).
        *   Language: Simplified Chinese.
        *   Real content (no Lorem Ipsum).
        *   Forms/buttons without actual submission.
        *   Design for 1440px width, responsive.
        *   No AI references.
        *   Professional look.

    *   `index.html`: Home page. Hero section, categories (Sichuan, Fast Food, Desserts, Healthy), featured restaurants.
    *   `restaurants.html`: List of restaurants. Filter/Search, list of cards with ratings, delivery time, and cuisine type.
    *   `restaurant-detail.html`: Specific restaurant page (e.g., "Chengdu Spicy Pot"). Menu categories, dish names, descriptions, and prices. A "Add to Cart" mechanism (simulated).
    *   `checkout.html`: Order confirmation. Summary of items, delivery address, payment method, and "Place Order" button.

    *   *Color Palette:* Vibrant orange/yellow (appetizing) mixed with white and light grey.
    *   *Typography:* Clean sans-serif.
    *   *Components:* Navigation bar, Footer, Cards, Grid layouts.

    *   *Home Page:*
        - Hero: "成都美食，极速送达" (Chengdu delicacies, delivered fast).
        - Categories: 川菜 (Sichuan), 快餐 (Fast Food), 奶茶甜点 (Milk tea/Desserts), 轻食 (Healthy).

    *   *Restaurant List:*
        -- "麻辣诱惑" (Spicy Temptation), "成都老味道" (Old Taste of Chengdu), "元气便当" (Genki Bento), "甜蜜时光" (Sweet Time).

    *   *Restaurant Detail (focusing on "成都老味道"):*
        - Dishes: 回锅肉 (Twice-cooked pork) - 38元, 麻婆豆腐 (Mapo Tofu) - 22元, 宫保鸡丁 (Kung Pao Chicken) - 35元.

    *   *Checkout:*
        - Address field: "成都市锦江区..."
        - Payment: Alipay/WeChat Pay.

    *   *index.html:* Needs a nice header, hero section, and category grid.
    *   *restaurants.html:* Needs a list of cards.
    *   *restaurant-detail.html:* Needs a menu layout.
    *   *checkout.html:* Needs a form and a total calculation summary.

    *   *Check:* No `target="_blank"`? Yes.
    *   *Check:* Relative paths? Yes.
    *   *Check:* No remote fonts/CSS? Yes (use system fonts).
    *   *Check:* No Lorem Ipsum? Yes.
    *   *Check:* No AI mentions? Yes.
    *   *Check:* Simplified Chinese? Yes.
    *   *Check:* Desktop width 1440px? Yes (max-width containers).
